how: tools/verify.py rebuilds wins, losses, ties, points for, points allowed, net points and winning percentage for all 32 teams from 150 games and compares them to the official NFL.com standings totals. Every value matched exactly, which also proves every individual score.

check: Every game row carries a working official NFL.com game URL
how: Each row's URL is checked against the official /games/<away>-at-<home>-<season>-reg-<week> pattern, and the Week 5 and Week 10 links were opened directly and confirmed to show the same scores.
The 13 games, their dates, kickoff times, broadcast networks, the Mexico City international designation and the six teams on bye were read directly from the official NFL.com Week 11 page.
Every listed player, position, injury description, practice designation and game status was transcribed from the official NFL.com injury report for the 28 teams playing.
Each is linked to the official NFL.com article that states it, rather than asserted from the injury report alone.
Every Week-w prediction is produced from games in weeks strictly less than w, and each opponent's season rate is also measured at the same information time.
A fixed seed and a fixed resample count mean re-running tools/build.py reproduces identical confidence intervals.

check: A strategy's improvement is statistically distinguishable from zero
how: The paired bootstrap interval, Bonferroni-adjusted for the number of strategies compared, still contains zero for every strategy. No strategy is marked eligible.
The NFL publishes none. Every market-line cell is blank and every value-based statement about edge, ROI or parlay pricing is omitted.
No consolidated league source exists. No player is assigned a depth rank.
NFL lists several of those matchups as to-be-determined, so only the completed weeks and the official Week 11 schedule are published.
